caveats: Q4 FY2026 revenue is derived (annual total minus year-to-date figure through 2026-05-10), not a directly reported quarterly figure.
The quarters differ in length. Q1 runs 2025-09-01 to 2025-11-23 and Q4 runs 2026-05-11 to 2026-08-30. Q4 is the longer period, so part of the increase reflects that and not only underlying growth.
No filing passages were provided, so no management explanation for the change is included.

claims.text: Costco's fiscal Q1 2026 revenue (2025-09-01 to 2025-11-23) was $67.307 billion.
Costco's fiscal Q4 2026 revenue (2026-05-11 to 2026-08-30) was $95.723 billion. This is derived as full-year revenue of $303.154 billion minus the $207.431 billion for the period to 2026-05-10.
Revenue increased about 42.2% from fiscal Q1 2026 to fiscal Q4 2026.
